lt.club.message.invite_1.succeed: : You've been given an item. Try holding it. We look forward to not knowing you.
lt.club.message.invite_1.fail: : We tried to give you an item, but your inventory was full. You can now find it in your collectibles basket. Try holding it. We look forward to not knowing you.
lt.club.message.invite_2.succeed: : We're glad you've come this far. Another item has been given to you.
lt.club.message.invite_2.fail: : We tried to give you another item, but your inventory was full. You can now find a second item in your collectible basket. We're glad you've come this far.
lt.club.message.invite_2.special: : We're glad you've come this far but for the love of disguises clean up your inventory a bit! That's TWICE! IN A ROW! Y'know how much it costs to send these messages?! No, wait, you don't get to know! You're probably doing this on purpose to bankrupt us! You're lucky we're not allowed to reject members. You can now find a second item in your stupid collectible basket ...
lt.club.message.door.scold: Now why would you walk into lava without protection?
lt.club.dialogue.gibnut.reject.2: : You've made it all the way here yet you lack what is needed.
lt.club.dialogue.gibnut.reject.4: : Until the time you return with five, non-milestone disguises, I will speak no further.
lt.club.dialogue.gibnut.reject.leave: : Hey! I wasn't done talking, where are you going? Who raised you?! Whatever ... I don't think you'll find enough disguises anyways.
lt.club.dialogue.gibnut.accept.2: : I was told to expect your company.
lt.club.dialogue.gibnut.accept.3: : That disguise is marvelous, an excellent choice.
lt.club.dialogue.gibnut.accept.4: : But here's me blathering on, knowing full well in your shoes I'd have little care for the meandering of an old man.
lt.club.dialogue.gibnut.accept.5: : Bah! So be it then. I won't keep you much longer.
lt.club.dialogue.gibnut.accept.6: : You'll want to take these coins. Oh and keep them close, yeah? You'll be needing them.
lt.club.dialogue.gibnut.accept.7: : Well now, unless you have something, I'll let them know you're ready. Farewell.
lt.club.dialogue.gibnut.accept.leave: : Hey! I wasn't done talking, where are you going? Who raised you?! Whatever ... I'll pass the word along to them that you're ready. Oh and take these coins. I think you'll find them helpful.

lt.river_race.trivia.question_1: What type of mining has destabilized the Mpanga River banks?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_2: What role do wetlands play in supporting the Mpanga River ecosystem?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_2.a: Water purification, flood control, and habitat provision
lt.river_race.trivia.question_3: Which industry contributes significantly to water pollution in the Mpanga River?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_4: The Mpanga River supports diverse ecosystems, including wetlands. Which species are commonly found in these wetlands?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_4.a: Tropical birds, amphibians, and native fish species
lt.river_race.trivia.question_4.b: Hippopotamus, Nile crocodiles, and African fish eagles
lt.river_race.trivia.question_4.c: African clawless otters, tropical fish, and waterfowl
lt.river_race.trivia.question_4.d: Vervet monkeys, African bush elephants, and antelope
lt.river_race.trivia.question_5: What effect has urbanization had on the Mpanga River?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_5.c: More awareness for conserving the Mpanga River
lt.river_race.trivia.question_6: What is a consequence of deforestation in the Rwenzori Mountains on the Mpanga River?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_7: Which local infrastructure near the Mpanga River has contributed waste to its waters?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_8: What is one of the main causes of soil erosion in the Mpanga River area?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_9: Which organization is actively involved in efforts to conserve the Mpanga River?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_10: Which activity has led to the reduction of wetlands near the Mpanga River?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_10.a: Agricultural expansion, urbanization and inadequate enforcement of environmental laws
lt.river_race.trivia.question_10.c: Fish farming, mining, and industrial activities
lt.river_race.trivia.question_10.d: Hydropower plants and taro & rice farming
lt.river_race.trivia.question_11: What are some of the key activities WEA women leaders engage in to benefit their communities?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_11.a: Saving indigenous seeds, protecting land rights, and launching sustainable farms.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_11.b: Building shopping centers and setting up markets.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_11.c: Importing agricultural machinery and recruiting foreign workers.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_11.d: Providing loans to local governments for environmental policies.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_12: Which of the following best describes the “ripple effect” created by WEA's projects?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_12.a: WEA leaders replicate their success, creating multiple circles of impact beyond the initial project.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_12.b: WEA leaders are restricted to specific areas and projects.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_12.c: WEA projects conclude after the first phase of training.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_12.d: WEA focuses exclusively on measurable outcomes in short-term studies.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_13: What is the focus of the Mpanga River cleanup efforts?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_13.a: Restore and protect the river and its wetlands
lt.river_race.trivia.question_14: What is the primary mission of Women's Earth Alliance (WEA)?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_14.a: To protect the environment, address climate crises, and support a thriving world through women's leadership.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_14.b: To build wells and provide short-term loans to women in rural communities.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_14.c: To fund environmental projects in urban areas across developed countries.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_14.d: To create economic opportunities through international corporate partnerships.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_15: Which sector does WEA primarily focus on in addition to environmental sustainability?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_16: Why are women specifically at the core of WEA's mission to address environmental and climate crises?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_16.a: Women are most impacted by environmental challenges and are effective at creating long-term, local solutions.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_16.b: Women have access to more government support than men.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_16.c: Women leaders can easily relocate to assist other regions.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_16.d: Women can more effectively build relationships with corporate partners.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_17: How many countries does WEA work with grassroots women leaders?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_18: How many years has it taken the WEA to catalyze over 52,000 women-led environmental projects?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_19: How does WEA measure its impact in communities?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_19.a: By the number of women trained, supported, and the broader community impact.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_19.b: By measuring the number of wells built annually.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_19.c: By tracking corporate investments in urban projects.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_19.d: By the number of one-time grants distributed.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_20: What are some of the core benefits that WEA-trained women leaders bring to their communities?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_20.a: Economic prosperity, conservation of natural resources, and cultural healing.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_20.b: Access to consumer goods, low-interest loans, and educational grants.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_20.c: Opportunities for global travel, government funding, and political connections.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_20.d: Partnerships with multinational corporations focused on tech.
lt.river_race.trivia.question_21: What is a primary approach WEA uses to support women-led environmental projects?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_22: How does WEA contribute to climate action?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_22.a: By empowering women-led, grassroots environmental projects
lt.river_race.trivia.question_22.c: By directly investing in oil-free technologies
lt.river_race.trivia.question_22.d: By lobbying for global warming policies in the UN
lt.river_race.trivia.question_23: Which type of native plant is being reforested the most along the riverbanks of the Mpanga?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_24: Which of the following is NOT a type of WEA-funded eco-enterprise being started by women leaders living by the Mpanga River?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_25: WEA supports women leaders from over how many communities globally?
lt.river_race.trivia.question_26: How many people have WEA's projects reached with climate solutions?

lt.quest.cents_intro.initial_contact.1: We like your Cents style. Come find us.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_agent.1: Ahh woah! Haha .. phew you scared me.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_agent.2: Was worried you were a .. ah it's not important.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_agent.3: What is important, however, is that you're here! We've been watching you y'know?
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_agent.4: And we like what we've been seeing.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_agent.5: As such, I've been told to extend you this offer.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_agent.6: Keep it close, yeah? Oh and watch yourself, the cliff caves 'round these parts can be treacherous ...
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_agent.cancel: Hey wait .. what .. where are you going?! I wasn't done talking!
lt.quest.cents_intro.enter_bunker.4: Don't answer that! Claire you know we can't ask them that.
lt.quest.cents_intro.enter_bunker.5: Sorry, she's not one for protocol. Please proceed.
lt.quest.cents_intro.enter_bunker.6: Oh but they can know my name though?!
lt.quest.cents_intro.enter_bunker.9: Anyways, the fact you're still here fills me with at least a little confidence.
lt.quest.cents_intro.enter_bunker.10: I'll add you to the door, just walk into it when you're ready.
lt.quest.cents_intro.enter_bunker.12: Oh can it Dan, no one asked.
lt.quest.cents_intro.enter_bunker.13: You, please, through the door. I need to go teach an oversized Gibnut what a fist tastes like.
lt.quest.cents_intro.enter_bunker.cancel: Or yeah, just leave, that's ... fine. Just come back when you're ready I guess?
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.1: Ah, the new recruits here! Over here by the desk.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.2: Welcome, welcome. I already know you'll be a great addition to our operation.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.3: This little corner of the map is where the magic happens.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.4: Quaint right? But low-profile is ideal, especially when you're trying to enact change like we are.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.5: Ah, but of course no one's told you the plan yet.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.6: We're going to steal the vote.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.7: And it's only right that Cents should be on top. They simply make the most sense.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.8: But you know what doesn't make sense? Those nonsensical anti-cent fools!
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.9: I just know they won't let this count play out by the book which is why we have to stop them.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.10: It's gonna take guts! It's gonna take guile! But we've got both by the boatload!
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.13: Haha, alright I like the energy!
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.14new: Oh and take these. The badge is for style, and the glasses are a nifty gadget we call the Nonsense Sensors.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.14: The plan's not ready, but our people are working on it as we speak.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.15new: Put 'em on and they'll reveal the fools who joined team No Cents.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.16new: I just know you'll do great things with us here.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.15: Take a look around, get to know the place.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.16: We'll contact you again once our plan is finalized.
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.17: For now, take this badge and go spread the word. Team Cents forever!
lt.quest.cents_intro.meet_leader.cancel: Where are you going?! Team Cents needs you!
lt.quest.no_cents_item.no_cents_badge.de: Oh my gosh and it's made of gold.
lt.quest.no_cents_item.buisness_card.des: Pristinely printed in 12 point Times New Roman.
Can paper even be this white??
lt.quest.no_cents_item.buisness_card.con:
Team No Cents. Ref: 98514
Invitation to join the cause.

29 133 -96
So you're a No Centless kind of person 'eh? You'll fit right in.
Find our campaign office near Parkour Cove and show them this card.
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_secretary.2: Welcome to the Team No Cents HQ - we run a tight ship here!
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_secretary.3: We're looking for unique individuals to help us win the battle against…
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_secretary.4: We don't say their name here…
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_secretary.5: Anyway - Leader Count Sense-less will want to speak to you soon. He should be in the planning office somewhere …
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_secretary.6: I'll give you a badge that gives you access.
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_secretary.7: When you find him, show him the badge and he'll know what's up.
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_secretary.c: W-wuh where are you going! Come back! I can be less sensible if that's the problem???
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.1: Well hello there… another volunteer for our important cause!
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.2: I'm Count Sense-less, the leader of the mighty No Cents Campaign!
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.3: I see Sam has already given you your badge, it's so good to have new volunteers.
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.4: We're in the midst of.. a bit of a battle against… well you know.
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.5: And we need every bit of help we can get!
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.6: It's always good to have another no nonsense person, ce-… the others simply can't have a place at the table!
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.7: But, I suppose you already know that…
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.8new: Anyways, you'll be wanting these. They're Cent Sensors.
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.9new: If you put them on, they'll reveal exactly who joined Team Cents.
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.10ne: And thank you again for volunteering with us!
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.8: There's plenty to do so don't be shy.
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.9: Ask around in the office and I'm sure we can find you a job.
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.10: If not, then I'll make sure the next mission that comes through gets assigned directly to you!
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.11: Thank you again for volunteering with us!
lt.quest.no_cents_intro.meet_leader.canc: Hey wait, come back! This'll be noted on your record!!

lt.edu.text.1.title: Territorial Governance and Indigenous Rights
lt.edu.text.1_1: Learners study land-use systems, sacred site protection, territorial mapping and political advocacy.
lt.edu.text.1_2: They compare Indigenous governance with national laws including Ecuador’s constitution which states that nature has rights.
lt.edu.text.1_3: Students are shown how to monitor territorial boundaries, document threats and how Indigenous law, cultural knowledge and modern legal tools can work together to defend their communities and ecosystems.
lt.edu.text.2.title: Rights of Nature and Human Rights
lt.edu.text.2_1: Students examine how rivers, forests, and ecosystems are considered legal entities that have the right to flourish, regenerate and be restored.
lt.edu.text.2_2: Learners analyze cases where communities use these rights to stop industries and the environmental damage they can cause.
lt.edu.text.2_3: They also study human rights, community self-determination and how climate justice, ecology and ancestral responsibilities intersect.
lt.edu.text.3.title: Youth Leadership and Community Communication
lt.edu.text.3_1: Through ancestral storytelling and modern communication tools, students learn how to document community life, territorial issues and environmental threats through photography, videography and drone mapping.
lt.edu.text.3_2: They also explore responsible use of AI for communication, cultural preservation and territorial defense
lt.edu.text.3_3: Students interview elders, create community reports and build digital content rooted in Indigenous values empowering youth to become spokespersons and guardians of their territories.
lt.edu.text.4.title: Reforestation, Forest Conservation, and Field Research / Project Design
lt.edu.text.4_1: Students learn hands-on ecological restoration techniques grounded in ancestral knowledge and modern science.
lt.edu.text.4_2: They study forest structure, species relationships, soil health and water systems while working with elders to identify culturally important plants and trees.
lt.edu.text.4_3: They learn how to design reforestation plots, how to conduct biodiversity surveys and how to use tools like GPS or drones for monitoring territories.
lt.edu.text.4_4: Emphasis is placed on protecting sacred sites, restoring damaged areas and building long-term conservation strategies.
